“她发烧了，我们不能带她走，上面的人说了出现发烧现象会变成丧尸，我们带着她，万一她变成丧尸怎么吧？”

“可是她是我们女儿……”

“大姨，我们时间不多了，快走吧。”

“诶，好，赶紧走吧。”

时笙迷迷糊糊的听到了一些对话，脑袋昏沉沉的很难受，她想睁开眼，可很快再次陷入了黑暗。

也不知过了多久，重物拖沓移动的声音在她耳边响起，由远及近……一股难闻的腥臭和腐烂味道冲鼻而来。

“喵！”

尖锐的猫叫声，让时笙瞬间惊醒，紧闭的双眼猛的睁开，一道黑影同时扑向她，尖锐的爪子按在她肩膀上，借着微弱的光线，时笙看到一张青灰色的脸，半边脸已经腐烂，一只眼珠子掉在外面，张着血口大盆，齿牙咧嘴的冲着她脖子咬过来。

我去，丧尸啊草！

一来就这么凶残，真的好吗？

本宝宝会有心理阴影的！

时笙抓着床上的枕头，挡住丧尸的嘴，这身体没什么力气，丧尸的嘴已经凑到她面前了，有冰凉的液体滴在她脸上，那味道很难闻。

妈的，简直就是在考验本宝宝的忍耐能力。

“嗬嗬！”

嗬嗬你大爷！

时笙动了动脚，踹向丧尸的肚子，丧尸被踹得一歪，那瞬间有冰凉的液体进入了时笙嘴里，没有异味，但是很凉，像是要把她整个人都冻起来。

这感觉也不过瞬间，快得时笙都没时间去反应。

丧尸‘嗬嗬’的爬起来，锲而不舍的朝着食物抓去。时笙来不及细想刚才自己吃了什么，身子一翻，滚到了地上，那只丧尸扑到了床上，凭着本能，朝着时笙爬过来。

时笙抖了抖身子，迅速爬起来，视线在两边扫了扫，左边有一个不大的柜子，她冲过去拎起就往丧尸脑袋上砸。

那丧尸喉咙里发出‘嗬嗬’的声音，时笙每砸一下，它就‘嗬嗬’一声，像是在给她加油助威似的。

这傻丧尸。

时笙丢掉柜子，看着床上已经没有动静的丧尸，甩了甩有些酸的手，这身体好弱啊！

喘了几口气，时笙摸着饿得咕咕叫的肚子，连剧情都来不及整理，往房间外面走——找吃的。

"She has a fever. We can't take her away. The people above said that if she has a fever, she will turn into a zombie. We are taking her with us. What if she turns into a zombie?"

"But she is our daughter..."

"Auntie, we don't have much time, let's go."

"Hey, okay, let's go quickly."

Shi Sheng vaguely heard some conversations, her head felt dizzy and uncomfortable. She wanted to open her eyes, but she soon fell into darkness again.

She didn't know how long it had passed before the sound of heavy objects being dragged and moved rang in her ears, from far to near... an unpleasant smell of fish and decay hit her nose.

"Meow!"

The sharp meow of a cat made Shi Sheng wake up instantly. Her closed eyes suddenly opened, and a black shadow rushed towards her at the same time, with sharp claws pressing on her shoulders. With the faint light, Shi Sheng saw a blue-grey face, half of the face was rotten, one eyeball fell out, a bloody mouth was opened, and the teeth were grinning and biting at her neck.

Let me go, zombies!

Is it really okay to be so cruel right from the start?

This baby will have psychological shadow!

Shi Sheng grabbed the pillow on the bed and blocked the zombie's mouth. Her body had no strength, and the zombie's mouth was already in front of her. There was cold liquid dripping on her face, and the smell was unpleasant.

Damn, this is simply testing this baby’s patience.

"Ho ho!"

Ho ho, you uncle!

Shi Sheng moved her foot and kicked the zombie in the stomach. The zombie was kicked sideways. At that moment, cold liquid entered Shi Sheng's mouth. There was no smell, but it was very cold, as if it was going to freeze her whole body.

This feeling lasted only a moment, so fast that Shi Sheng didn't even have time to react.

The zombies got up with a "ho ho" sound, and persevered in grabbing the food.Shi Sheng didn't have time to think about what he had just eaten. He rolled over and rolled to the ground. The zombie threw himself on the bed and crawled towards Shi Sheng based on instinct.

Shi Sheng shook her body, quickly got up, and scanned both sides. There was a small cabinet on the left. She rushed over, picked it up, and smashed it on the zombie's head.

The zombie made a "ho ho" sound in its throat. Every time Shi Sheng hit it, it made a "ho ho" sound, as if it was cheering her on.

This stupid zombie.

Shi Sheng threw away the cabinet, looked at the zombies on the bed that were no longer moving, and shook his sore hands. His body was so weak!

After taking a few breaths, Shi Sheng touched his hungry stomach. He didn't even have time to sort out the plot and walked out of the room - looking for something to eat.
